description: TXN-LOCAL, in-process lockers (two Workspaces, one process), resolution orders that no record exercised (a-commit-b-commit, a-rollback-b-commit and the reversed owner orders). Per phase both Workspaces BeginTrans, A updates and B updates with Errors before/after, then they resolve in the stated order, then both rows are read. Phases: far rows (T 1 / T 64) with A:C then B:C, A:R then B:C, B:C then A:C, B:C then A:R, A:C then B:R; another table (T 1 / U 1) with A:R then B:C; the same page (T 1 / T 2) with A:C then B:C; the same row (T 1 / T 1). Finally a fresh Workspace reads after a pause and Idle. Asks whether the admitted cases keep both owners' changes in every order, and whether the in-process refusal (3188 earlier) is the same for near rows.
